items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: When I left to form my band, the first man I had on trumpet was Dave Page.

ctx.x: But when this thing got to going so far, and what I tell you with the Curly Hammonds and the Versewis Harrison and Leroy the Ballet, and they all got real gangsterized over there, I says, time to leave.
When I left to form my band, the first man I had on trumpet was Dave Page.
You know Dave (inaudible) my band, don't you?
